events.title: "White Album" Released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic "White Album" was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: More than just an album, The Beatles' "White Album" dropped on this day in 1968, proving they could do anything they wanted and still top the charts. A masterpiece.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire and electrify. A true legend.

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived on this day in 1965, showcasing their evolving sound and songwriting brilliance. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980, and would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace resonate as strongly today as ever. Imagine.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible life and artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Forever a starman, forever changing the game.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still gets us all shook up. Thank you, thank you very much.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page. The guitar riffs he gave us are still sending shivers down our spines. Rock on.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Still sailing, still rocking! Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. What a voice, what a career.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: One step beyond! Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Suggs, the voice of Madness. Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home... and today, it's his birthday! Happy 71st to the fantastic Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Working 9 to 5 and still looking fabulous! Dolly Parton would have been 81 today. An absolute icon whose music continues to inspire.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Still going strong after all these years! Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow. A true pop legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get going... and celebrate a birthday! Happy 77th to the fantastic Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was officially enshrined as the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction. Who was your favourite inaugural inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Still shining bright! Happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen. Here's to more great music.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles took to the rooftop of Apple Corps for their iconic final public performance. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Against all odds, Phil Collins turns 76 today! A true music legend, from Genesis to solo superstardom. Happy birthday, Phil!

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Day The Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. Sixty-eight years ago, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, known for his timeless hit "Never Gonna Give You Up," celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and we're never gonna give up celebrating him! Happy 61st birthday to the wonderful Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, and his message of peace and unity still resonates globally. Get up, stand up.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Award-winning singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: You've got a friend in Carole King, who turns 85 today! A songwriting genius whose influence is still felt everywhere. Happy birthday!

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012, and would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and powerful songs are forever etched in music history. Always loved, never forgotten.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop phenomenon Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering the day millions of hearts broke: Take That announced their split on this day in 1996. Thankfully, they came back stronger than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and a happy birthday! Wishing a fantastic 68th to Ali Campbell, the voice of UB40. Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Thinking Out Loud, it's Ed Sheeran's birthday! Happy 36th to the man who consistently delivers the hits and the heart. What's your favourite Ed track?
